pairs.l: 1 — You can't afford to make another mistake. It could really cost you.
pairs.r: F — Think twice before you make your next move.

pairs.l: 2 — Take your mind off it and relax. I'd be happy to make the choice for you.
pairs.r: C — You can leave this decision to me.

pairs.l: 3 — If you'd thought carefully, you wouldn't be in this position. Just accept it.
pairs.r: B — It's time to face the consequences.

pairs.l: 4 — It's a tough choice but I can't wait for your response any longer.
pairs.r: A — You need to make up your mind.

pairs.l: 5 — It couldn't be prevented. You can get over it. Time fixes everything.
pairs.r: D — Things will work out for you eventually.

r1.exp: Poruka 1 (ne možeš si priuštiti još jednu grešku, dobro razmisli) = F (Think twice). Poruka 2 (opusti se, ja ću donijeti odluku umjesto tebe) = C (You can leave this decision to me). Poruka 3 (trebao/la si bolje razmisliti, suoči se s posljedicama) = B (It's time to face the consequences). Poruka 4 (ne mogu dulje čekati tvoj odgovor) = A (You need to make up your mind). Poruka 5 (nije se moglo spriječiti, stvari će se srediti) = D (Things will work out eventually).

r6.exp: 'Your efforts are no longer appreciated at the office, so maybe you should start looking for something else. We can go through the OPTIONS' → razgovarati će o promjeni posla = A.

r7.exp: 'Can't wait' = jedva čekam → uzbuđen je i raduje se posjetu = C (looking forward to it).

r8.exp: 'My regular college studies have PRIORITY, my schedule is just TOO BUSY' → nema vremena = B.

r9.exp: 'He succeeded in MAKING US WANT TO BUY the app' = uvjerio ih je → prezentacija je bila uvjerljiva = A (convincing).

r10.exp: Jo je otišla u dućan i platila €10 više od popustne cijene (€35 + €10 = €45) → platila je €45 = B.

r11.exp: 'Uncommon ones were actually TRANSPORTED IN SECRET' = prokrijumčarene = A (sneaked in).

r12.exp: 'Cherry blossom... in SPRING' → Hanami se prakticira u jednom određenom godišnjem dobu = B.

r13.exp: 'Focused on One Thousand Springs: an artistic installation presenting 5,000 HAIKUS' → izložba poezije (haiku) = B.

r14.exp: 'Walk in search of autumn leaves – an activity that HAS NOT BEEN OFFERED BEFORE' → novo je traženje jesenskog lišća = C.

r15.exp: 'A WORKSHOP on Japanese garden design will help learn zen-garden techniques' → praktične vještine na radionici = C.

r16.exp: 'Main benefit is freedom, (16)____.' → F: as you can travel at your own speed and change plans at any time. Sloboda = putovati vlastitim tempom.

r17.exp: 'Backpackers who hike long distances, (17)____.' → C: need gear that is both functional and comfortable. Za duge pohode treba funkcionalna i ugodna oprema.

r18.exp: 'Backpackers who explore unknown routes (18)____.' → D: rely on these gadgets to ensure they do not get lost. GPS uređaji su ključni za nepoznate rute.

r19.exp: 'Trips range from weekend to months-long, (19)____.' → B: and they call for careful planning and preparation. Svako putovanje zahtijeva pažljivu pripremu.

r20.exp: 'Researching the area and packing appropriately, (20)____.' → A: so that the journey can be safe and enjoyable. Svrha istraživanja i pakiranja je sigurno i ugodno putovanje.

r21.exp: 'Arrive AT their European destinations' — prijedlog 'at' uz odredišta (destinations).

r22.exp: 'Where individual specimens HAD grown up' — past perfect u zavisnoj rečenici (radnja prethodila glavnoj prošloj radnji).

r23.exp: 'Not known IF the Painted Lady returned...' — 'if' uvodi neizravno da/ne pitanje (nije se znalo da li...).

r24.exp: 'Did INDEED return to Africa' — 'indeed' = doista, zaista (naglašava potvrdu nakon prethodne neizvjesnosti).

r25.exp: 'Taking advantage of favourable winds' — participski prilog (participle clause): taking = koristeći prednost.

r26.exp: 'To whoever COULD invent a timepiece' — modalni glagol 'could' u prošlosti (hipotetska sposobnost u prošlom kontekstu).

r27.exp: 'Wide VARIATIONS in temperature, pressure and humidity' — fiksna kolokacija: wide variations = velike varijacije/razlike.

r28.exp: 'Accepted the CHALLENGE' — 'challenge' = izazov. Harrison je prihvatio izazov pronalaska točnog pomorskog sata.

r29.exp: 'Having already DESIGNED clocks with moving parts made from wood' — past participle u perfektnom participu: having designed.

r30.exp: 'Some time LATER watches' — 'later' = kasnije. Najprije morski satovi, a zatim nešto kasnije džepni satovi.

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) što radiš kod kuće i zašto, (2) kada si počeo/la raditi kućanske poslove i kako si ih naučio/la, (3) koji je tvoj omiljeni kućanski posao i zašto. Dužina 80–100 riječi. Neformalan registar.

w1.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (80–100 riječi).
